\section{Occupation}
We write the occupation in terms of the reduced energy, where $\xi = \beta\epsilon/2$:
\begin{equation}
\frac{1}{e^{\beta\epsilon}+1} = \frac{e^{-\xi}}{e^{\xi}+e^{-\xi}} .
\label{eq:occ}
\end{equation}
\section{Spectral weight}
In this section we measure energies from the level instead, where $\xi = \beta(\epsilon-\epsilon_d)/2$, so that
\begin{equation}
\frac{1}{e^{\beta(\epsilon-\epsilon_d)}+1} = \frac{e^{-\xi}}{e^{\xi}+e^{-\xi}} .
\label{eq:spec}
\end{equation}
